limitations: Read-only DOM collector adapted to the browser tool; ordinary form values were not read.
Prototype-only controls, sanitized comment/site/badge fixture values and variable counts were excluded.
Hidden-state copy is included. Closed shadow roots, external frames, native dialogs and pseudo-elements are not covered.
The inventory deduplicates copy across states; per-state visibility and duplicate channels are not retained.
Production captures use an isolated fixture API. Live backend, CAPTCHA services, SMTP and Telegram were not exercised.
